newsitem.title: UK: Lloyd's of London profit outlook improves -analyst.
newsitem.headline: Lloyd's of London profit outlook improves -analyst.

text.p: Profits for the 1994 year at Lloyds of London insurance market look set to be better than it expected a year ago, analyst Chatset said on Tuesday.

"This year (1994) has continued to show a very promising trend, the profit looks even better than we were predicting a year ago at 1.058 billion stg," Chatset, a part of Lloyd's members agency Christie Brockbank Shipton said in a statement.
Lloyd's, which reports profits three years in arrears, in July announced a 1.1 billion stg return to profit on the 1993 year after a string of record losses totalling more than 8.0 billion stg.
Chatset said 1995 was a harder year to forecast than 1994, but expected a profit of 900 million stg, adding that it was another year when insurance claims generally remained low.
The forecasts, which were contained in Chatset's latest publication "1993 Lloyd's League Tables", are after the effect of a special levy on both the 1994 and 1995 years.
Chatset said the publication has been expanded this year to provide more detailed information on corporate investors in Lloyd's and Members Agents' Pooling Arrangement (MAPAs) investment schemes.
